Here's a bit more practice for our last midterm this Wednesday. This does *not* replace the review sheet and you should definitely study that as well. 


## Problems

2. Express 
    $$
    \frac{1}{z} e^{z^2}
    $$
    as a power series.  
    Note: There might be a $1/z$ term in there.

<!-- -->

4. Suppose I tell you that 
$$\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} \frac{(-1)^{n+1}}{n^{1/2}} \approx 0.604899.$$
Can you give me a good numerical approximation to $\zeta(1/2)$?

5. Let $L$ denote the straight line segment from $0$ to $1+i$. Set up and evaluate 
$$
\int_L e^z dz.
$$

6. Let $C$ denote the positively oriented circle of radius 5 centered at the origin. Evaluate 
$$\int_C f(z) \, dz$$
for each of the following functions:

   a. $f(z) = 1/(z-10)$
   b. $f(z) = z/((z-2)(z-10))$

<!-- -->

8. Find and classify the fixed points of $f(z) = z^3 - \frac{i}{2}z^2 + z$.
